name: the-panel-describes-row-zero-rather-than-the-lit-one
the-panel-draws-with-nothing-lit
why: EQUIVALENT, and kept because the reason is worth reading. Removing the `row < 0` guard leaves `frame.rows[-1]`, which is `undefined` for an array, so itemStatRows answers [] exactly as the guard does - there is no input that tells them apart. The guard stays because the day this reads `rows.at(row)` instead, -1 stops meaning 'nothing' and starts meaning THE LAST ROW: the panel would quietly describe the bottom of a pile the player has no highlight in. It is a line about intent, not about today's behaviour, and no pin can honestly claim otherwise.
